title: Filter with Guards
goal: Refine a match arm with a condition without losing exhaustiveness.

source.attribution: adapted from Day 2 Morning: Pattern Matching

hints: Patterns check shapes and constants, but extra runtime conditions on variables require `if` after the pattern.
The match must still cover every variant of `Status`, including `Finished`.
explanation: The fallback arm has to cover every variant you did not name. Listing only `Status::Pending` leaves `Finished` unhandled, so the match is not exhaustive and the compiler rejects it with `E0004`.
